manifest.name: resume-localize-cn2en
manifest.description: Resume localization CN→EN for technical roles: demotes service-industry stints, strips demographic fields, converts duties into quantified outcomes, unifies spelling and date formats, keeps the document ATS-parsable, and returns a full change log.

bundle.text:
# resume-localize-cn2en bundle patch: registers the skill with DSH.
# Ships SKILL.md only — no host-process code, no browser client.
- insert:
    - id: resume-localize-cn2en
      name: 'resume-localize-cn2en'

readme.text:
Convert a Chinese resume into an English resume for technical roles: reshape the content for the reader's expectations first — the translation is the easy half.

把中文简历改写成英文技术岗简历：先按目标市场的阅读预期重塑内容——翻译是容易的那一半。

The English tech market reads resumes as evidence: a recruiter scans for what you shipped and what it changed. Chinese resume conventions (duties, demographic fields, enthusiasm prose) actively work against that scan. This skill reshapes content for the reader's expectations — the translation is the easy half.

英文技术市场把简历当证据读：招聘方扫的是"你做成了什么、改变了什么"。中文简历惯例（职责罗列、人口统计学字段、抒情自评）恰好妨碍这种扫描。这个 skill 按读者预期重塑内容——翻译只是容易的那一半。

readme.section: What it changes / 它改什么
readme.text:
| 中文简历惯例 | 英文技术市场预期 |
|---|---|
| 性别 / 年龄 / 照片 demographic fields | removed — discrimination-safe hiring |
| 服务行业经历 full entries | demoted; cut entirely when stronger material exists, compressed to one line when it is the only history |
| 职责 duty lines ("负责后台系统开发") | quantified outcomes with numbers |
| 热情洋溢的自我评价 enthusiasm prose | calm sentences with figures |
| mixed formats | one spelling variant (AU/US), one date format, ATS-clean layout |

readme.section: Worked example (fictional fixture from the live test run)
readme.text:
```
Before:  负责后台系统开发
After:   Built the order-processing backend, cutting order cycle time from 40 min to 15 min.
```

Numbers missing from the source are never invented: the skill batches one question list for the user and marks placeholders `[X]` instead. 截断/乱码段落标记出来提问，绝不擅自脑补。

readme.section: What you get back / 你会拿到什么
readme.text:
1. The localized resume — ATS-parsable, one spelling variant, one date format, 至今 rendered as `Present`.
2. A change log covering every cut and every added number.
3. A batched question list for the facts only you can supply (one message, not twenty).

readme.section: Honest limitations / 如实说明局限
readme.text:
- Quantified outcomes need the candidate's real numbers; the skill flags `[X]` rather than inventing figures, so output may arrive with questions attached.
- ATS rules differ by applicant system; "clean" here means standard headings and no tables — not a guarantee with any specific parser.

量化成果需要候选人提供真实数字；skill 标注 `[X]` 而不编造，所以产出可能带着问题清单。各 ATS 解析规则不同；这里的"干净"指标准标题与无表格——不保证任何特定解析器。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ChenneyZhuang/resume-localize-cn2en ~/.claude/skills/resume-localize-cn2en
```
